scientific_scope.statement: Core Lean 4, no import. Namespace Exact with its own polynomial arithmetic on coefficient lists (cf, padd, pscale, pmul schoolbook, peq ignoring trailing zeros), own bilinear form, halfNorm = (b,b)/2, dd = d_i, own box enumeration mybox (last coordinate outermost). ClearedEq1 G a P: P(0) = 1 and, at every b in mybox a, P_b (q)_b = sum over all c in mybox b of q^((c,c)/2) P_c ((q)_b/(q)_c)^2 ((q)_b/(q)_(b-c)), an identity in Z[q]. ValleyFree h: no i < j < k with h j < h i and h j < h k. RegradedValleyFree h: some e > 0 divides every exponent with nonzero coefficient and m -> h (e m) is ValleyFree. Conjecture73_exact: for all G, R, a with Toda.Admissible G, Toda.IsRootSystem G R, a.length = G.length and every P with ClearedEq1 G a P, RegradedValleyFree (cf (P a)).
scientific_scope.not_claimed: Not the clearing of denominators in Q(q), not the source's uniqueness sentence for rational functions, not the source's Theorem 1.1, not the identification of Admissible + IsRootSystem data with split semisimple Lie algebras (all prose, see EXACT_FORM.md). Not that the side conditions of cleared_unique hold for every admissible G. Not a general theorem that ratio times qfac is qfac (checked at every pair of states of the three boxes). Nothing about simply laced types, the class-wise form, author intent or priority. Not a recovery of the reviewer's lost scratch file: a rebuild from the excerpt in ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.md.
scientific_scope.scope_sentences_to_carry: Exact.not_conjecture73_exact refutes the denominators-cleared consequence of Definition 1.1 of arXiv:2502.10655v3 with the regraded no-dip conclusion. That conclusion is weaker than the source's literal 'unimodal', so the negation holds a fortiori for the literal reading. The binding to the rational functions of Definition 1.1 uses one line of algebra in Q(q) (division by the nonzero (q)_b^3) plus either the source's own uniqueness sentence or its Theorem 1.1, and neither is in Lean. The side conditions of cleared_unique are decided at the three witnesses, not proved for every admissible Gram matrix. The B_2 witness is a census-agent finding of 2026-09-19 made during formalisation, not the recorded model discovery of 2026-09-10; the recorded witness 1 + q^2 is regraded-unimodal (b3_110_is_regraded) and refutes only the literal reading.
